"VAMPIRE: THE MASQUERADE – BLOODHUNT

Android 3D Game Development Prompt

Create a realistic 3D third person Android vampire battle royale game titled Vampire: The Masquerade – Bloodhunt.

The game should feature a dark, modern Gothic version of Prague with detailed buildings, narrow streets, castles, rooftops and underground locations.

Include realistic vampire characters, male and female character options, different vampire clans, supernatural abilities, fast movement, rooftop climbing, jumping and third-person combat.

Build a battle royale experience with solo, duo and squad modes. Include weapons, ammunition, loot collection, health, blood resources, enemy encounters and a shrinking playable area.

Create a detailed vampire headquarters called Elysium where players can select characters, customize outfits, manage inventory and enter matches.

Include realistic 3D graphics, cinematic nighttime lighting, rain, fog, dynamic shadows, atmospheric music and supernatural visual effects.

Design smooth Android touchscreen controls with a movement joystick, camera control, shooting, aiming, jumping, climbing, weapon switching and ability buttons.

Add online multiplayer, matchmaking, player profiles, friends, character customization, progression, missions and leaderboards.

Optimize the game for Android smartphones with adjustable graphics settings, smooth animations, responsive controls and stable performance.

Final Goal: Create a fully playable, realistic 3D Android vampire battle royale game with immersive Gothic environments, supernatural gameplay and functional multiplayer systems.

Use properly licensed original game assets and branding, or authorized original alternatives. (3D Game, Phone/Tablet)

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
"

## Objective
- Build a complete, playable mobile-friendly 3D vampire battle royale game with a Gothic Prague setting, supernatural gameplay, and touch controls.

## Requirements
- Use properly licensed original assets and branding, or authorized original alternatives.
- Support Android phones/tablets, responsive touch controls, and adjustable graphics settings.
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.

## Decisions
- Implemented an original browser-based game, “Veil of Prague — Nightfall Protocol,” with procedurally generated Three.js scenery and original interface branding rather than licensed franchise assets.
- Multiplayer, profiles, progression, missions, and leaderboards are not connected to online services; gameplay currently uses local AI opponents.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added lobby, mode selection, clan selection, settings, match HUD, and match results interface.
- Added procedurally generated Gothic Prague environment, player/AI vampire characters, rain, lighting, loot, combat, abilities, shrinking zone, keyboard/mouse controls, and touch controls.
- `node --check game.js` passed before the latest edit.
- Started local server with `python3 -m http.server 3002`; browser successfully loaded `http://localhost:3002`.

### Active
- Validate the latest geometry change and inspect gameplay visually; latest screenshot command timed out while waiting for fonts.
- Continue testing match controls and mobile layout.

### Blocked
- Browser showed a 404 for `/favicon.ico` (noncritical); visual screenshot not captured yet.

## Next Move
1. Run `node --check game.js` after the latest edit.
2. Retry browser screenshot using `playwright-cli` with a workaround for screenshot/font timeout; inspect the latest JPEG.
3. Exercise lobby-to-match flow and verify mobile controls/settings and gameplay progression.
4. Report that this is a playable local prototype and identify online multiplayer/backend features as not implemented.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Game screens and UI markup.
- `style.css`: Gothic styling and responsive/mobile layouts.
- `game.js`: Three.js world, gameplay logic, AI, controls, and UI interactions.

## Important Context
- Latest edit in `game.js` changed building window generation from both building faces to one face to reduce geometry load; revalidate rendering.
- `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` succeeded, reporting one console error (favicon 404) and GPU readback performance warnings.
- Changes are uncommitted.
